recordings.sourceTitle: Shostakovich: Prelude & Fugue No. 6 in B Minor, Op. 87 – Sofia Sacco (Piano)
recordings.notes: Performer-published film from Sofia Sacco's complete Op. 87 cycle at the Royal Academy of Music, produced by Fly on the Wall with City Music Foundation support. Replaces the Ashkenazy Topic upload following a request to avoid potentially disruptive ads. Monetization is not publicly verified; this is an alternative performance, not a guarantee of ad-free playback. No timing from the former upload is reused.

verification.method: Work number, key, performer/channel and 01:53 chapter checked against the live YouTube watch-page title and description. Public player metadata reported status OK and playableInEmbed true; these flags do not measure ads or guarantee playback in every session. The filmed cycle is corroborated at https://sofiasacco.com/shostakovich-50. No score-to-recording anchors measured.

notes: Reference annotations from Algomus; these are analytical readings, not automatic detections.
Analysis only: no verified recording-specific synchronization is available. No playback timing has been estimated.

Entry endpoints mark the onset of the final note, as defined by the reference source. They do not assert the full sounding duration. Split-voice entries use the reference transition boundary and share a groupId.

Measure lengths and piece extent derive from the credited MIDI encoding, including its terminal track position. Opening pickups and a truncated final MIDI bar are represented explicitly; this is not a critical edition of the printed score.
